## Recommendation 3: Install a Dedicated Gas-Phase Charcoal Trap or Catalytic Oxidation System for Tritium (CH₃T) Removal

**Specific technology:** A heated palladium/platinum catalytic oxidation converter followed by a molecular sieve trap (3Å or 5Å zeolite), or alternatively a room-temperature activated charcoal cold trap, specifically sized to absorb tritiated methane from the xenon gas stream.

**Justification:** The tritium requirement is the most demanding periodic constraint: 10 Bq injected must fall to < 10 µBq within 90 days — a reduction of 10⁶, corresponding to ~20 half-lives of an effective removal process, or reliance on the 12.3-year physical half-life of tritium (which contributes negligibly).
